headline: Is ServiceNow Stock a Buy After the Accenture AI Launch?
summary: ServiceNow shares are up Wednesday on its AI-powered services launch with Accenture and Guggenheim's upgrade to Buy with a $125 target.

headline: Here's How Much $1000 Invested In ServiceNow 10 Years Ago Would Be Worth Today
summary: ServiceNow (NYSE:NOW) has outperformed the market over the past 10 years by 9.42% on an annualized basis producing an average annual return of 22.98%. Currently, ServiceNow has a market capitalization of $106.52
